name: Revit ↔ Claude MCP Bridge
tagline: Drive Revit with natural language through the Model Context Protocol.
description: A bridge that lets an AI assistant query and modify a live Revit model over MCP — reading model data and executing authoring code from natural-language instructions.

page.problem: Repetitive Revit tasks still require manual clicks or bespoke scripts.
page.solution: An MCP server exposing safe Revit operations an assistant can call directly.

highlights.headline: 20 MCP tools let Claude query and edit a Revit model.
points: Two-server chain: main.py speaks MCP, pyRevit Routes executes inside Revit.
Covers document, model, view, family, and status tools, plus code execution.
execute_revit_code runs arbitrary IronPython against the open model from chat.
